changes.summary: renderPage and renderTextLayer take an optional AbortSignal and cancel the in-flight pdfjs task (task.cancel() / layer.cancel()) on abort; a new render is never started on a canvas that is still rendering.
the paint effect owns one AbortController per run, passes its signal to both pdfjs calls, aborts on cleanup, and swallows the expected cancellation while still rethrowing anything else.
the z1 text layer is `select-text` while no draw tool is armed and `select-none` while one is, so native text selection works without a gesture selecting text.
new test: a page change re-paints with a fresh signal and unmount aborts it.
new test: the text layer's select class follows `drawing`.

decisions: Cancel the previous render rather than skip the new one: the newest page is the one that must win.
The text layer re-enables selection itself; the stage keeps `select-none` for overlays.
The leader-indicator page source is left alone and raised (see analyze.json.open_questions).
